comment: No source is published. The gate opening is the strike envelope plus the level, clamped to 0 and 1; it sets both the amplifier gain and the corner of two cascaded one pole filters, whose angular frequency is 628.3185 at the bottom and 151424.77 at the top, which is 100Hz and 24100Hz. The LEVEL jack multiplies the knob rather than adding to it, at a tenth per volt, so a cable resting at 0V silences the module. The Decay knob is a rate, not a time: process() multiplies the envelope by the exponential of minus the knob times the sample period each sample, so a higher setting is a shorter decay. The two knobs have no lettering on the panel.
